data.gender_notes: Raqeem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Means the wise, the intelligent one. Derived from the Arabic word ‘ar-raqim’ which means ‘a wise or intelligent man’. The name Raqeem carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raqeem usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raqeem total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

historical_references.reference: In the older Arabic literature, Raqeem is mentioned as a name of an idol worshipped in the pre-Islamic Arabian culture. It is believed that Raqeem was the patron deity of the tribe of Qayil and its god of rain and vegetation.

The name Raqeem is also found in the Quran, where it is mentioned as one of the names given to Allah (God in Islam). This use of the name signifies the 'Gracious' or 'Generous' nature of Allah towards his creation.
